title: Buffalo Chicken Wings

items.item: Frank's RedHot Original Buffalo Wings Sauce

instructions: Lay the wings flat in a single layer in a pan. (If you'd like smaller pieces, cut each wing in half at the joint.)
Pour the Frank's RedHot Buffalo Wings Sauce over the wings and spread it around so they're coated.
Broil, keeping a close eye on them, until the tops look lightly charred with small brown bubbles forming — not burnt.
Take the pan out, flip the wings, add a little more sauce, and broil again until the tops are lightly browned.
Switch to bake at 350°F for 10 minutes so the wings finish cooking through.

tips.title: Watch the broiler
tips.text: Broilers vary a lot — stay by the oven. The wings go from brown bubbles to burnt fast.

notes: No quantities were specified in the original (it was spoken/transcribed) — use enough wings to fill a pan in a single layer and enough sauce to coat both sides. Prep time and cook time are estimates; broil time depends on your broiler.
